name: POS reservation dialog
describe: Table reservation dialogs over a bg-black/50 scrim: Reserve Table (create, max-w-2xl, h-740), Edit (h-840, with a table select), Cancel Reservation, Complete Reservation (customer arrived) and the Table Reserved buffer-time warning.
Opened from the Tables screen (create, warning) and from the card menu of the Reservations route (edit, complete, cancel).
